info.title: PretasiPlus API contract
info.description: Generated from packages/contract (zod). Do not edit by hand: run `npm run contract:emit`.

Id.description: Opaque entity id (string). Never parse or construct on the client.

ClientUuid.description: Client-generated UUID used as an idempotency key.

Timestamp.description: ISO 8601 instant serialised in Malaysia time (+08:00).

TimestampInput.description: ISO 8601 instant with an explicit offset (or Z).

RoleCode.description: Role code. admin = Admin Pusat, school_admin = Admin Sekolah, ppd_officer = Pegawai PPD/JPN, teacher = Guru, student = Murid, parent = Ibu Bapa, sponsor = Penaja.

fields.description: Field name to BM message, for VALIDATION_ERROR.

details.description: Structured extras (e.g. candidate schools for AMBIGUOUS_USERNAME).

retryAfter.description: Seconds until a retry is allowed, for RATE_LIMITED.

label.description: Chip text value, formed by the server (BM).

via.description: mod_pelajar while the student mode is on.

isTest.description: Data written under the mode is stamped is_test.

capabilities.description: Keys from capabilitiesFor(role, scope): <item>.read, plus <item>.write for F/S modes.

schoolId.description: Needed only when a username exists in more than one school.

AuthErrorCode.description: Error codes of the auth and session endpoints, in addition to the generic ones.

GamificationLedgerKind.description: Type of a syiling ledger row.

progress.description: Equals target when already completed today.

rate.description: Syiling per token of the caller tier.

rarity.description: common | rare | epic | legendary; any other value gives no items.

progress.description: Only the 5 "kuiz" badges carry progress; others are null.

total.description: Size of the whole catalogue, regardless of the rarity filter.

profileUrl.description: Link to the caller own profile (host is a mock constant).

perks.description: A list, a JSON-array text or one text. Absent keeps the stored list (create: empty list).
A list, a JSON-array text or one text. Absent keeps the stored list (create: empty list).

sort.description: One of total_syiling_earned, current_syiling, token_balance, level; any other value is ignored.

page.description: An invalid page reads as 1; an out-of-range page is an empty list.

type.description: earn | spend | convert | bonus | refund; any other value gives an empty result.

dateFrom.description: YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive; a malformed value is ignored.

dateTo.description: YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive; a malformed value is ignored.

value_sen.description: Alias of valueSen (the live form posts this name).

openNow.description: "Buka serta-merta": create as open instead of draft.

liabilityRm.description: Sum of costValueSen of the claims in the session year / 100.

cat.description: A category key or "all"; an unknown value gives no rows and activeCat null.

categoryLabel.description: The long table label of the category (BM, with emoji).

ids.description: Reward ids; unknown ids are ignored, duplicates collapsed.

status.description: A status key or "all"; absent = pending_admin; any other value gives an empty list and activeStatus null.

cat.description: A category key or "all"; an unknown or repeated value gives activeCat null.

AccessRoleModes.description: Access mode per role. A missing key means hidden for that role.

ppdOnly.description: Visible to a PPD (district) officer only, hidden for JPN (state) officers.

prototypeScope.description: D43: true when the item maps to a row of role-access-matrix.md for school_admin (shown in the v2 prototype). False for the admin and ppd_officer views.

items.description: Item labels where the requirements name them.

inV2Prototype.description: D43: the group hosts at least one prototype item of role-access-matrix.md.

labelSource.description: proposed = the doc describes the group but gives no exact copy.

row.description: Row # of role-access-matrix.md section B; 0 = section A.

Shows the conversion rate of the caller tier, the quick amounts and the tier grid.

post.summary: Convert syiling to tokens at the tier rate
post.description: tokens = floor(syilingAmount / rate). Atomic: debits syiling with a ledger row (type convert, source token_conversion, description "Tukar {s} syiling → {t} token"), then credits the tokens. Success is 200, not 201. There is no daily cap.

post.summary: Redeem a catalogue reward with tokens
post.description: One transaction: snapshot redemption row, token debit (source hadiah_redeem, ref redemption:{id}), stock - 1 when stock is limited. Checks run in this order: reward exists and is active, stock, monthly cap (non-cancelled redemptions of that reward in the Malaysia calendar month), token balance. Any refusal rolls back everything.
